Heard Sri Ram Murat, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel for the respondents and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the petitioners in the instant petition also ought to be given the benefits which flow out of Section 31 of the Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act, 2013').

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the benefits which flow out of the Act, 2013 have been made applicable to the acquisitions which have been made under the National Highways Act, 1956.
In this regard, learned counsel has relied upon the order of this Court dated 21.02.2023 passed in Writ-C No.21601 of 2022.
